title: Anthropic Prices IPO at $83 Per Share, Begins Trading as 'ANT' in Largest-Ever Stock Offering
summary: Anthropic priced its Class A shares at $83, above its $70–$78 target range, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion fully diluted. The offering raised approximately $81.3 billion, surpassing SpaceX's June 2026 IPO as the largest in history. Shares begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT on November 19.
why: AI基础设施最大IPO于今日开盘，对科技股情绪、AI板块隐含波动率及Nasdaq 100整体走势有实质影响；持仓中的谷歌/GOOGL与腾讯均是Anthropic股东，受益程度值得追踪

title: Trump Arrives in Shenzhen for APEC, US-China Bilateral with Xi Jinping Scheduled Nov 19
summary: President Trump traveled to Shenzhen for APEC, with a bilateral meeting with President Xi Jinping scheduled for November 19 and discussions on trade, AI chip restrictions, and a potential US-China-Russia trilateral on nuclear arms. The visit comes days after Washington tightened AI chip export rules targeting overseas data centres used by Chinese firms.
why: 中美领导人直接会谈是决定AI芯片出口管制走向与贸易关税节奏的关键窗口；会谈结果将直接影响腾讯/阿里/美团等中国科技股估值，以及NVDA/MU等美国半导体股波动率

title: US Commerce Tightens AI Chip Export Rules to Close China's Overseas Data Centre Loophole
summary: The US Commerce Department issued an interim final rule requiring overseas data centres to obtain export licences before providing large volumes of advanced computing power to China-headquartered firms, closing a gap exploited through facilities in Singapore, Malaysia, and other third countries. The rule applies immediately and affects cloud providers serving Chinese AI developers.
why: 直接约束腾讯云/阿里云海外算力扩张路径；正值APEC峰会谈判前夕，规则落地时机具有信号意义；对NVDA/AMD中国市场前景产生持续下行压力，本轮事件仍在发展中

title: Nvidia Investors Urge Board to Reinstate Jensen Huang; Board Confirms No Reinstatement at Nov 17 Earnings Call
summary: Nvidia investors sent open letters urging the board to reconsider reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO after his November resignation. At the November 17 quarterly earnings call, the board confirmed it would not reinstate Huang. CFO Colette Kress remains interim CEO while a formal CEO search is under way.
why: 英伟达CEO真空期持续影响公司AI芯片战略执行与市场信心；AI芯片龙头的领导层不确定性已压制NVDA估值，间接影响持仓的AI算力主题仓位；CEO搜寻结果仍未明朗

title: A股三大指数盘中走弱，算力芯片板块下挫，国资国企改革配套文件正式实施
summary: 11月19日A股低开走低：沪指跌0.44%、深证成指跌0.51%、创业板指跌0.63%；算力芯片板块受AI出口管制消息压制，天普股份等个股跌停。与此同时，国资国企改革配套文件正式生效，19家公司披露新回购或增持计划。
why: A股大盘及算力板块走势影响AI基础设施相关标的；国企改革文件落地为相关央企股提供中线支撑，算力板块压力与APEC会谈预期形成博弈

title: 腾讯Q3 2026业绩：总收入2073亿元增8%，企业云收入增35%，资本开支大幅跃升226%
summary: 腾讯2026年第三季度总收入2073亿元，同比增8%；金融科技及企业服务（含云）收入同比增35%；资本开支651亿元，同比增226%，显示AI基础设施投入进入高速扩张期。IFRS净利润636亿元，同比增0.8%。
why: 腾讯是持仓核心标的，云业务35%增速及226%资本开支增幅证实AI货币化加速，对中期股价逻辑构成正面验证；高资本开支意味着利润率短期承压，需关注后续盈利指引

title: Alibaba Reports Fiscal Q2 2027 Results: Cloud Revenue Growth Hits 22-Quarter High on AI Monetization
summary: Alibaba's fiscal Q2 2027 (July–September 2026) results showed cloud revenue growth reaching a 22-quarter high, driven by full-stack AI monetization and enterprise AI adoption. The company described AI investments as accelerating returns, with consumption and cloud segments jointly driving solid overall performance.
why: 阿里巴巴是持仓核心标的，云业务22季度高点增速验证AI货币化投资逻辑；港股9988.HK及美股BABA的中期估值将受益于云增速加速，同时需关注管理层对消费复苏及资本开支计划的具体指引
